Structured Utterance v0.3 qualification validation
Date: 2026-08-24
Interpreter: Open Object Rexx 5.3.0 r13196 Internal Test Version
Current API baseline: oorexxapis(4).zip supplied in this qualification

Dependencies used:
- Alchemy Objects v0.8 (v0.4.3+ adoption surface remains compatible)
- ooRexx Crypto v0.1
- Interaction Event v0.3
- Runtime Registry v0.14

Direct package result: PASS (15/15 requested tests)

Validated surfaces:
- structured segment/lineage/privacy model
- generation-intent and information-use integrity
- cross-act sensitive-information commercial-repurposing detection
- Structured Utterance -> Interaction Event v0.3 native evidence bridge
- native information-use / generation-intent / derived-finding export
- deidentified projection removes raw sensitive source prose while preserving structured residue
- BrandExperienceContext is sealed with its owning utterance; canonical evidence cannot drift after seal
- legacy free-form ids that cannot satisfy Interaction Event opaque-token fields return INTERACTION_NATIVE_TOKEN_INCOMPATIBLE instead of raising syntax
- Runtime Registry v0.14 stage/activate/acquire/release for API structured.utterance/0.3

Downstream compatibility evidence:
- Brand Interaction Effect v0.6 complete suite: PASS (24/24) against this repaired package and Interaction Event v0.3
- Reputation Feed v0.10 Structured Utterance acquisition bridge: PASS

Qualification boundary:
- The current AI Access/provider contract returns flattened provider reply text/model/finish metadata and does not expose a package-native Structured Utterance handoff. Provider/model output -> Structured Utterance is therefore NOT proven as an authoritative package contract by the current baseline. It requires producer/orchestrator integration while pre-flattening intent/lineage is still available.

See VALIDATION_TRANSCRIPT.txt for the direct executed suite.
